query: SELECT 'columns' AS section, coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.table_name,c.ordinal_position),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM (SELECT table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,column_default,is_identity,identity_generation FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('transmission_routes','evidence_transmission_routes')) c UNION ALL SELECT 'constraints',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) ORDER BY k.table_name,k.constraint_name),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT r.relname AS table_name,c.conname AS constraint_name,c.contype,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class r ON r.oid=c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=r.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND r.relname IN ('transmission_routes','evidence_transmission_routes')) k
